title: Erdős problem #628: chromatic splitting
statement: If a Kₖ-free graph has chromatic number k and a,b≥2 with a+b=k+1, then it has two disjoint subgraphs of chromatic numbers at least a and b.

counterexample.description: In the first unresolved parameter pair (a,b)=(2,5), a connected K6-free graph with chromatic number exactly 6 such that deleting the endpoints of every edge leaves a 4-colorable graph.
